svg.text: NLB target modes: how traffic reaches the ui Pod
The Service, the NLB and its TCP :80 listener are identical — only the target group changes
If that node runs no ui Pod, kube-proxy forwards
to a node that does — one more hop.
Every Pod has a routable VPC IP from the VPC CNI,
so the NLB connects to it directly.
IP mode removes a network hop and drops the need to reason about externalTrafficPolicy.
It is also the only mode that works for Pods running on AWS Fargate.
